cat > rosterkit/contacts.py <<'EOF'
"""Contact sheet for substitute teachers."""

from typing import Iterable, List
from rosterkit.models import Student


def _check(students: List[Student]) -> None:
    if not students:
        raise ValueError("no students to list")
    for student in students:
        if not student.email:
            raise ValueError(f"no email for {student.display_name}")


def contact_rows(students: Iterable[Student]) -> List[str]:
    """Rows of name, section and email, sorted by name and aligned."""
    ordered = sorted(students, key=lambda item: item.display_name.casefold())
    _check(ordered)
    name_wide = max(len(item.display_name) for item in ordered)
    sect_wide = max(len(item.section) for item in ordered)
    return [
        f"{item.display_name:<{name_wide}}  {item.section:<{sect_wide}}  {item.email}"
        for item in ordered
    ]
EOF
cat > tests/test_contacts.py <<'EOF'
import unittest

from tests.support import data_file
from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.contacts import contact_rows


def make(last, first, section, email="a@x.org"):
    return Student("id", last, first, section, email)


class ContactTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_sorted_and_aligned(self):
        rows = contact_rows([make("Zed", "Al", "B"), make("Ames", "Bo", "A10")])
        self.assertEqual(rows[0], "Ames, Bo  A10  a@x.org")
        self.assertEqual(rows[1], "Zed, Al   B    a@x.org")

    def test_missing_email_names_student(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as caught:
            contact_rows([make("Ames", "Bo", "A", None)])
        self.assertIn("Ames, Bo", str(caught.exception))

    def test_empty_list_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            contact_rows([])
EOF
